'''Tagabawa''' is a [[Manobo languages|Manobo language]] of [[Davao City]] and [[Mount Apo]] in [[Mindanao]], the [[Philippines]]. Tagabawa is spoken in [[Cotabato]] and [[Davao del Sur]] provinces, and on the slopes of [[Mount Apo]] west of [[Davao City]],<ref>''[[Ethnologue]]''</ref> The language is spoken by the [[Lumad#Bagobo|Bagobo Tagabawa people]].
